claim_boundary.claim_if_null: Drive-local Pythia-1B eraser covers did not resolve Stage 27N's row-consistency failure; next cross-scale work should move to class-local covers, larger splits, or patch-style interventions.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: The Stage 27N cross-scale row-consistency failure is improved by drive-local Pythia-1B output-side eraser covers, supporting drive-specific cover granularity as the correct cross-scale control surface.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim cross-architecture steering, complete circuits, exact model-wide causal explanation, durable weight edits, open-ended generation control, raw CAS-symbol understanding, or universal Pythia-1B control from Stage 27O.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27O is bounded cross-scale evidence for drive-local calibrated output-side eraser-cover intervention over Pythia-1B CPL2 likelihood margins. It is not cross-architecture evidence, not weight editing, not complete circuit discovery, not model-wide control, and not visible free-form generation control.

formal_anchor: Drive-local refinement of the Stage 27N cross-scale calibrated eraser protocol, preserving the same split and candidate component universe while changing only cover granularity.

gates.criterion: Stage 8 Pythia-1B CPL2 PASS and Stage 27N GREY-positive source contracts are verified.
gates.name: source_contracts

gates.criterion: The loaded Pythia-1B causal LM revision matches f73d7dcc545c8bd326d8559c8ef84ffe92fea6b2.
gates.name: model_revision

gates.criterion: All seven Foundation drives produce exactly six learned eraser components from learn rows only.
gates.name: drive_local_cover_contract

gates.criterion: Evaluation uses the Stage 27N split: exactly 56 held-out rows, 8 held-out rows per drive, and no learn/eval overlap.
gates.name: controlled_split

gates.criterion: Drive-local calibrated eraser suppression beats matched random eraser suppression on at least 60% of 56 held-out rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: drive_local_eval

gates.criterion: Passing drive-local mode must have positive mean increment and positive increment share at least 55%.
gates.name: positive_effect_floor

method: Commit this pre-registration, runner, and tests before any Stage 27O GPU result is generated.
Verify Stage 8 Pythia-1B CPL2 PASS and Stage 27N GREY source contracts.
Use the same Stage 27N Pythia-1B selection seed and learn/eval split to isolate cover granularity as the changed variable.
Enumerate the same Pythia-1B output-side candidate components over layers 12-15.
For each Foundation drive, learn a separate eraser cover on that drive's 8 learn rows only.
For each Foundation drive, choose one eraser scale from the fixed grid by maximum mean margin increment on that drive's learn rows.
Evaluate each drive-local cover only on held-out rows from its matching drive.
Compare held-out increments against matched random covers sampled separately for each drive-local cover.
motivation: Stage 27N showed positive mean Pythia-1B eraser steering but failed row-consistency against matched random controls. Stage 27O tests the most direct fix: learn and calibrate separate output-side eraser covers per Foundation drive.

required_inputs.random_control_policy: each drive-local eraser cover compared against matched random covers for the same drive and same selected scale
required_inputs.stage27n_failure_mode: positive mean lift but insufficient row-consistency against random controls
